title: The Competence Penalty
hook: Being the best at your job is the fastest way to get stuck.
script:
(Visual: Split screen. Left side: An employee efficiently finishing a complex task. Right side: A manager dumping five more files on their desk.)

Voiceover: In the corporate world, the reward for efficiency isn't a promotion or a break. It’s more work.

(Visual: Text overlay: The Competence Penalty)

Voiceover: When you become the 'go-to' person for a specific problem, you become too valuable to move. You aren't being promoted; you're being anchored. 

(Visual: Person looking at a promotion chart while remaining in the same spot.)

Voiceover: Management doesn't want to lose their most reliable tool. By solving every crisis, you've made yourself indispensable in a role you've already outgrown.

(Visual: Person politely saying 'no' or delegating.)

Voiceover: Stop optimizing for utility. Start optimizing for replaceability.
caption: The more indispensable you are in your current role, the less likely you are to leave it. High performance without strategic visibility is just a recipe for burnout. Stop being the "fixer" and start being the leader. #RationalThoughts #CorporateIndia #CareerStrategy #FirstPrinciples
